description: Starts a video generation for the signed-in user (text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, Seedance edit/extend, Genjutsu, etc.). When to use: only after estimate_cost with matching inputs. Cost: spends credits up to max_credits when queued. Returns: generation_id and polling guidance. See estimate_cost for which source fields apply to each mode.

duration.description: Output duration in seconds when applicable.
duration.title: Duration

end_frame_generation_id.description: image_to_video: optional end frame from a completed Vidaro image generation id.
end_frame_generation_id.title: End Frame Generation Id

end_frame_image_url.description: image_to_video: optional end frame as a public https image URL.
end_frame_image_url.title: End Frame Image Url

end_frame_upload_id.description: image_to_video: optional end frame as an upload id (models with an end-frame slot; see get_model images.slots).
end_frame_upload_id.title: End Frame Upload Id

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio when supported.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

image_generation_ids.description: Genjutsu slots; also reference images for reference_to_video and kling-4 video_edit (image generation ids).
image_generation_ids.title: Image Generation Ids

image_upload_ids.description: Genjutsu slots; also reference images for reference_to_video and kling-4 video_edit (upload ids).
image_upload_ids.title: Image Upload Ids

image_urls.description: Genjutsu slots; also reference images for reference_to_video and kling-4 video_edit (https URLs).
image_urls.title: Image Urls

keyframe_generation_ids.description: image_to_video: middle keyframes from Vidaro image generation ids (added after keyframe_upload_ids).
keyframe_generation_ids.title: Keyframe Generation Ids

keyframe_image_urls.description: image_to_video: middle keyframes as https image URLs (added last).
keyframe_image_urls.title: Keyframe Image Urls

keyframe_upload_ids.description: image_to_video: ordered middle keyframes as upload ids (e.g. kling-4, max 8; see get_model images.lists).
keyframe_upload_ids.title: Keyframe Upload Ids

prompt.description: User prompt; required for most modes.
prompt.title: Prompt

reference_video_generation_ids.description: reference_to_video: reference videos from Vidaro video generation ids.
reference_video_generation_ids.title: Reference Video Generation Ids

reference_video_upload_ids.description: reference_to_video: reference videos as upload ids (kling-4 max 5, minimax-h3 max 3).
reference_video_upload_ids.title: Reference Video Upload Ids

reference_video_urls.description: reference_to_video: reference videos as public https URLs.
reference_video_urls.title: Reference Video Urls

result_index.description: When source generation has multiple outputs, pick result index.
result_index.title: Result Index

source_generation_id.description: image_to_video: start frame from a Vidaro image generation id.
source_generation_id.title: Source Generation Id

source_image_url.description: image_to_video: https URL of start image.
source_image_url.title: Source Image Url

source_upload_id.description: image_to_video: upload id of start image.
source_upload_id.title: Source Upload Id

source_video_generation_id.description: video_edit/extend: source Vidaro video generation id.
source_video_generation_id.title: Source Video Generation Id

video_upload_id.description: Genjutsu: source video upload id. reference_to_video: one reference video (prefer reference_video_upload_ids).
video_upload_id.title: Video Upload Id
